:::{#exm-score-equation}
#### Score equation of a Bernoulli sample

For $n$ independent Bernoulli observations with $r = \sum_i y_i$ successes,
the score is $\sum_{i=1}^n (y_i - \pi)/\paren{\pi(1 - \pi)} = (r - n\pi)/\paren{\pi(1-\pi)}$
(summing @exr-derive-bernoulli-score over the observations),
so for $0 < r < n$ the score equation $(r - n\pi)/\paren{\pi(1-\pi)} = 0$
has the single solution $\pi = r/n$.
:::
